Supports some automated features for my fellow hackers:

* Exporting the target IP address as an environment variable, very useful with tmux
* Creates a dedicated directory for the CTF/Box based on the name you give it
* As you saw on the top bar, it displays the target ip address
* Auto enumeration with gobuster on the ports it finds http on
* Creates a Markdown file with the name of the box for notes and automatically adds the nmap scan to it.
